clue.text: Opposed to wearing soles, perhaps affectedly dressy

explanation.surface: A man wears padded underwear as a safety measure.

explanation.definitionFit: To enshield is an old literary verb meaning to shield, guard or cover against harm.

clue.text: Changing into suits, needing introduction in applying for jobs

clue.text: Very best among pre-Raphaelites

clue.text: Earthen crocks in Persian city

clue.text: Immature pup intoxicated with beer aroma

clue.text: Ingredient that can be hot or cold, reportedly

explanation.walkthrough: The joke is that the same sound covers both extremes: the fiery pepper and the word for cold.

clue.text: Try and obtain leverage with a handle?

clue.text: Wasp: 'I distractedly go around houseplant'

explanation.definitionFit: The aspidistra is a hardy, broad-leaved plant long popular in British parlours as a houseplant.

clue.text: 'Northern Ireland' on agenda after 'Welcome'; in charge you'll find cynic

clue.text: Such noses? Upturned & blunt, primarily!

parts.note: opening letter

opening letter
opening letter

explanation.definitionFit: A snub nose is short, blunt and turned up at the tip, exactly as the clue describes.

clue.text: Catholic Church upset seeing Celtic half back

clue.text: Go round and round wasting time in underwear
